verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE whose agents take chat instructions and read, write, and modify files across one or more workspaces, orchestrating multi-step workflows. Its dedicated multi-file Diff Review page, with accept, reject, and undo controls, confirms edits spanning several files. Community users report using it happily, though a demo showed the agent choosing a hardcoded 298px value over a proper CSS approach. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of plain-language feature/bug fixes spanning multiple files, evidence of implementation quality on complex changes.
